usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.groups.update("group_id", name: "string")
pp result

fields.name: name
fields.description: New display name for the group.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Updated display name for the group.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the group was created.

fields.name: is_scim_managed
fields.description: Whether the group is managed through SCIM and controlled by your identity provider.
